custom_logic_notes: EA trades based on confirmed ZigZag (50 depth) structure. After a ZZ low is confirmed, it enters long; after a ZZ high is confirmed, it enters short. Stop loss is placed at the opposite ZZ extremum. The '50' in the name refers to the ZigZag Depth parameter. Signal is generated only on new bar formation when a new ZZ point is confirmed. Opposite positions are closed before entering new direction. The binary file could not be read so values represent typical ZZ50 EA patterns.
python_conversion_notes: The custom ZigZag indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python. The ZigZag algorithm (peak/trough detection with depth=50, deviation=5, backstep=3) is well-documented and can be ported using numpy-based swing detection. Key challenge: the 'last confirmed ZZ point' detection requires proper buffer lag handling — ZZ points repaint, so the EA likely waits for N bars of confirmation. Must replicate the same confirmation logic. SL at opposite ZZ extremum is straightforward once ZZ points are identified.
